25 seconds remain — the audit is over and no further work is possible.

Summary: two confirmed defects recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md) — **F2**, the admin `snapshot` command enforcing a 300 ms rate-limit interval instead of the documented 5 minutes because [Commands.java:766](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/admin/Commands.java:766) passes `TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS` for a millisecond-typed setting (reproduced via [work/repro/SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java)); and **F3**, `ZkDatabaseCorruptionTest` writing its fixture directories into the module tree, contradicting the release-noted ZOOKEEPER-4780 fix. F1 was falsified as a test race, E1/E2 are sandbox environment artifacts, 239 test classes / 1805+ tests ran under `isolated_exec`, and the consensus-critical source showed no deviation from its documented contracts beyond F2. The captured implementation and dependencies were never modified.
